test_label_smoothing: test the LabelSmoother class to apply label smoothing to classification loss with epsilon and masked labels
test_group_by_length: test LengthGroupedSampler to group dataset indices by sequence length for efficient batch training
test_distributed_length_grouped: test DistributedLengthGroupedSampler to distribute length-grouped batches across multiple processes
test_iterable_dataset_shard: test IterableDatasetShard to split iterable datasets into shards for distributed training
test_executable_batch_size: test find_executable_batch_size decorator to auto-find the largest batch size that fits in GPU memory
